idea-plugin.name: Slow Build Hotspots
idea-plugin.description:
Slow Build Hotspots

Every second of build time costs developer focus. Slow Build Hotspots analyzes your Gradle builds to pinpoint the exact tasks, cache misses, and non-incremental operations that are slowing you down — with actionable optimization recommendations.

Key Features

  • Build Profile Analysis — Parses Gradle --profile and build scan data
  • Slow Task Identification — Ranked list of the most time-consuming build tasks
  • Cache Miss Analysis — Detects tasks that should be cached but aren't
  • Non-Incremental Detection — Finds tasks that rebuild unnecessarily
  • Performance Dashboard — Visual breakdown of build time by task, phase, and module
  • Optimization Suggestions — Specific, actionable recommendations per task

Why Slow Build Hotspots?

Developers lose hours per week to slow builds. This plugin transforms Gradle's raw profiling data into clear, prioritized optimization opportunities that deliver measurable build time improvements.

Free vs Pro

  • Free: Build profile analysis, slow task identification, cache miss analysis, optimization suggestions
  • Pro: Build time trend charts over time, team build comparison, regression alerts, CI build analysis, and historical performance tracking
